bride.name: Sanghamitra
bride.family: Eldest daughter of Smt. Laxmipriya Sahoo and Sri Baburam Sahoo

groom.name: Ananta
groom.family: Youngest son of Smt. Kabita Pradhan and Sri Arakhita Pradhan

welcome.message: Together with our families, we invite you to celebrate our wedding and bless us as we begin our life together.
welcome.shloka:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
welcome.translation: O Lord with the curved trunk and mighty form, radiant as a million suns, please remove all obstacles from my endeavors, always.

story.title: Two names. One beginning.
story.intro: Known to those closest to them as {brideNickname} and {groomNickname}, {bride} and {groom} invite you to share the first page of their married life.

illustrations.alt: Copper kalash with a coconut and mango leaves
illustrations.caption: An auspicious welcome

gallery.caption: Where words fall silent, love speaks...
A little warmth, a little magic, and endless togetherness...
And then came the moment that made it official...
Two hands, two hearts, and one beautiful promise...

events.name: Mangalkrutya
events.subtitle: Auspicious beginnings
events.description: The pre-wedding observance opens the celebrations.
events.significance: Pre-wedding observances mark an auspicious beginning and offer a time for families to seek blessings for the marriage.

events.name: Marriage
events.subtitle: The wedding ceremony
events.description: Join both families in blessing the couple on their wedding day.
events.significance: The wedding ceremony brings the families together as the couple make their commitment to a shared life.

events.name: Panigrahana
events.subtitle: The joining of hands
events.description: Panigrahana is part of the wedding-day ceremonies.
events.significance: In Panigrahana, the taking of the hand symbolizes the couple’s commitment as they enter married life.

events.name: Reception
events.subtitle: Dinner and celebration
events.description: Please join both families for dinner and celebration.

calendar.description: We would be delighted to celebrate our wedding with you.

rsvp.message: Please let our family know if you’ll be joining us. We look forward to celebrating with you.

footer.message: Your presence and blessings will mean so much to us.
footer.compliments: With best compliments from the Sahoo family, friends and relatives.
